function.arguments: {"finding": "The email channel has a much higher average revenue per completed order ($44.72) than the paid_search channel ($23.47), but this is likely due to confounding by customer segment: the email channel was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have higher average order values. A direct comparison of average revenue between channels is not valid without adjusting for segment.", "implication": "The raw difference in average revenue cannot be interpreted as the campaign's effect. function.name: note_finding
